import gc
import json
import sqlite3
import weakref
from pathlib import Path
import pytest
from orze.core import research_interfaces as registry
from orze.engine import native_cpu_action as native

class RetentionProbe:
    def pytest_sessionstart(self, session):
        self.before = {"contexts": len(registry._CONTEXTS), "runs": len(registry._RUNS), "owners": len(native._OWNERS)}
    def pytest_sessionfinish(self, session, exitstatus):
        collected = gc.collect()
        runs = tuple(registry._RUNS.values())
        owners = tuple(native._OWNERS.values())
        unique_sources = {id(run["sources"]): run["sources"] for run in runs}
        source_bytes = sum(len(item.content) for source in unique_sources.values() for item in source._owner.items)
        engines = {}
        closure_edges = []
        for owner in owners:
            callback = owner.admission
            for name, cell in zip(getattr(callback, "__code__", None).co_freevars, callback.__closure__ or ()):
                value = cell.cell_contents
                if name == "engine":
                    engines[id(value)] = value
                    closure_edges.append({"task_id": owner.handle.idea_id, "freevar": name})
        engine_details = []
        for engine in engines.values():
            path = Path(engine.lake.db_path)
            with sqlite3.connect(path.as_uri()+"?mode=ro", uri=True) as conn:
                attempts = conn.execute("SELECT task_id,state,terminal_json FROM execution_attempts ORDER BY task_id").fetchall()
                reservations = conn.execute("SELECT state FROM cpu_action_reservations").fetchall()
            try:
                engine.lake.conn.execute("SELECT 1")
                connection_closed = False
            except sqlite3.ProgrammingError:
                connection_closed = True
            engine_details.append({
                "database": str(path), "engine_cpu_closed": engine._cpu_closed,
                "active_handle_map_size": len(engine._cpu_handles), "lake_connection_closed": connection_closed,
                "attempts": [{"task_id": row[0], "state": row[1], "outcome": json.loads(row[2])["outcome"]} for row in attempts],
                "reservation_states": [row[0] for row in reservations],
            })
        report = {"pytest_exitstatus": int(exitstatus), "gc_collected": collected, "before": self.before,
            "after_gc": {"contexts": len(registry._CONTEXTS), "runs": len(registry._RUNS), "owners": len(native._OWNERS)},
            "terminal_owners": sum(owner.terminal is not None for owner in owners),
            "held_owners": sum(owner.held for owner in owners),
            "unique_prepared_sources": len(unique_sources), "retained_source_content_bytes": source_bytes,
            "retained_source_items": sum(len(source._owner.items) for source in unique_sources.values()),
            "retained_engine_count_via_admission_closure": len(engines), "closure_edges": closure_edges,
            "engines": engine_details,
            "interpretation": "Measured after existing test fixture teardown and gc; no registry was cleared. Engine closure is one observed strong path, not claimed to be the only root (atexit also retains callbacks)."}
        print("\nRETENTION_DIAGNOSTIC="+json.dumps(report, sort_keys=True))
raise SystemExit(pytest.main(["-q","-p","no:cacheprovider",
    "tests/test_cpu_proposal_product.py::test_policy_builds_experiment_then_analysis_from_new_artifact_ids",
    "--tb=short"], plugins=[RetentionProbe()]))
